title: Kaash
desc: Following a serious box office flop, movie star-turned-producer Ritesh (Jackie Shroff) and his wife, Pooja (Dimple Kapadia), are forced to downgrade to a simpler lifestyle. This leads to the husband becoming an alcoholic, the wife taking a menial job as a chambermaid, and their young child being forced to watch as his parents' relationship disintegrates. Ritesh and Pooja are living apart when their son is diagnosed with a fatal brain tumor, which leads to a bittersweet reunion for all three.

title: Waqt
desc: An earthquake tears a businessman's family apart. Years later, they reunite in a courtroom trial where the father meets his sons under unprecedented circumstances.

title: Aurat Teri Yehi Kahani
desc: An honest journalist is illegally detained in a mental asylum when he tries to expose two corrupt politicians. After his release, he plans to exact revenge on the people who wronged him.

title: Bhrashtachar
desc: Journalist Bhavani intends to expose and bring to justice a corrupt politician who pretends to be a social worker; however, she soon finds herself trapped in a web of conspiracies.
